label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y harás dos anillos de oro, y los pondrás sobre dos extremos del joshen, sobre su labio que a lado del efod hacia adentro.
spanish: Y harás dos anillos de oro, y los pondrás sobre dos extremos del pectoral, sobre su labio que a lado del efod hacia la casa.
grammarChanges: Replaced the untranslated transliteration 'joshen' with 'pectoral' for הַחֹשֶׁן (H2833, common noun), matching the rendering already used for this noun in the surrounding verses of this chapter.
Replaced 'hacia adentro' with 'hacia la casa' for בָּיְתָה (H1004 'house' plus directional he) so the noun house is kept in the Spanish rather than resolved only as 'inward'.
readerNote: The literal noun 'casa' is kept for the directional form בָּיְתָה instead of the interpretive 'hacia adentro'.
